races.paceDynamic: La Belle Forest and Alkuwarrior will contest the early lead in this sprint, with La Belle Forest looking the more reliable pace-setter given her front-running style and recent form. The presence of two leaders should create an honest gallop over 5f on good ground, preventing the race from becoming a crawl. Arctic Wind, Guernsey Lady and Arishka's Dream will track the leaders prominently, while Tie Fighter and Beach Partee will need to come from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can settle just behind the leaders and kick when the pace-setters weaken in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Forest and Alkuwarrior duel early and weaken
scenarios.body: The honest pace will set up perfectly for horses tracking in second or third, allowing them to strike when the leaders tire. Guernsey Lady and Arctic Wind are ideally positioned to exploit this scenario with their prominent styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Forest gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: With Alkuwarrior's poor recent form, La Belle Forest might get easier fractions than expected and prove hard to peg back. Her trainer Archie Watson's 14-day record is poor but she has winning form at this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and collapses late
scenarios.body: Strong early fractions from the dual pace-setters could set up a scenario for the back markers to finish fastest. Tie Fighter with first-time headgear and Beach Partee dropping in class could benefit from a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go off too conservatively
scenarios.body: A messy, slowly-run sprint would turn this into a dash from the 2f pole, suiting horses with natural speed regardless of position. This would be the least likely outcome given both leaders' known styles.

watchPoints.text: Watch if La Belle Forest gets an uncontested lead as Alkuwarrior has been finishing last recently and may not provide the expected early pressure.
Monitor Tie Fighter's early position as first-time cheekpieces could sharpen him up significantly for this handicap debut.
Observe how Arishka's Dream settles early after going off too fast on his turf debut at Ripon last time.
Check if Beach Partee can improve enough to justify the visor addition and 9lb weight drop from his recent Bath run.
Watch Arctic Wind's jump from the gates as his last start saw him beaten 7 lengths in a small field despite gelding operation.

races.paceDynamic: Toralou is the only confirmed front runner with prominent runners Opening Bat, Devious Devan, Thiscouldbefun and Norflondonforever likely to track close behind. With just one natural leader, Toralou should dictate a sustainable tempo without early pressure, allowing the pace to build gradually through the middle stages. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Nakaaha, Grey Soul, Auburn Avenue, Sea The Light, Mereside Madness, Eagle Day, Orchard and Sixfiveseven will be relying on the pace quickening late. This setup clearly favours prominent racers who can sit close to Toralou's measured gallop and kick when the tempo lifts, rather than horses coming from the back who need a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Benefits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Toralou leads uncontested and the prominents track comfortably behind her measured gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will be steady early allowing Opening Bat, Devious Devan and Thiscouldbefun to conserve energy in striking positions. When the tempo lifts in the final three furlongs, these prominent racers will have first run on the large field of hold-up horses who need more pace to be effective.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses press Toralou early creating a stronger gallop than expected
scenarios.body: The increased pace will set up perfectly for the back-markers to close strongly in the final furlong. Nakaaha and Grey Soul, both effective from off the pace, will benefit most from this tactical development.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Toralou Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Toralou's sustainable pace proves too strong and she maintains her advantage to the line
scenarios.body: Her front-running style will be perfectly suited to dictating terms without pressure, using her turf form advantage. The hold-up horses will find her lead too substantial to peg back despite their late flourish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is very slow with no pressure on Toralou through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole where class and finishing speed matter most. This tactical development would suit horses with the highest ratings regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Toralou must be monitored early as the sole pace setter - if she goes too slow or faces unexpected pressure the race shape changes completely
Opening Bat and Devious Devan both show prominent tendencies and could press Toralou early if their jockeys are aggressive from the gates
Thiscouldbefun returns from 167-day break with 5lb claiming jockey which could provide significant weight advantage if fitness holds
The ground conditions favour turf specialists over AW performers like Eagle Day and Orchard who may struggle on this surface
Nakaaha drops back to her optimal one-mile trip after disappointing over longer distances this season

races.paceDynamic: Aravalli is the sole confirmed front runner in this field of nine, giving him a significant tactical advantage on this flat Ffos Las track. With eight hold-up horses behind him, Aravalli can dictate a comfortable tempo without early pressure, allowing him to conserve energy for the finish. The lack of pace pressure means the race will likely develop into a sprint finish from the back, but Aravalli's uncontested lead gives him first run on his rivals. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and any horse with early speed who can track the leader closely.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Aravalli gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Aravalli to control the race completely, getting first run on the field when the pace quickens. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back against a horse with such a tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too slow and allows class horses to unleash finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Aravalli's modest ability gets exposed when the better handicappers like Salkadan and Kelly Burn produce strong finishes. The combination of class and stamina tells in the final furlong despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Aravalli stops quickly and multiple horses charge from the back
scenarios.body: The front runner's limitations are brutally exposed as he weakens rapidly, creating a mad scramble from the pack. Higher-rated horses with proven stamina like Reem Rak and Brave Leader benefit from the sudden pace injection.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If headgear change or longer trip transforms a lesser light
scenarios.body: Al's River's new blinkers or Mick The Hat's step up in distance unlocks hidden improvement. The tactical setup and weak pace allows an outsider to spring a surprise at rewarding odds.

watchPoints.text: Watch if any horse shows early speed to challenge Aravalli - this would completely change the race dynamics
Monitor Salkadan and Kelly Burn in the market as the two most likely to overcome the tactical disadvantage
Check if Al's River settles better with first-time blinkers as headgear could unlock improvement
Watch for Reem Rak getting good early position as Varian runner has best form when able to give true running
Observe if Mick The Hat shows more enthusiasm over this longer trip after poor shorter-distance efforts

races.paceDynamic: Lamlash is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and should get an uncontested lead through comfortable fractions. With Belle Amie the only prominent runner, the pace will be steady rather than strong, allowing the majority hold-up horses to get into contention. The moderate early gallop will set up a sprint finish from the back markers. This race shape clearly favours strong finishers and hold-up horses who can produce their best work late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lamlash sets modest fractions and the hold-up brigade get racing room
scenarios.body: The steady pace allows closers like Belle Amie and Highland Harvey to unleash their finishing kicks effectively. Buck Barrow and Change Of Fortune also benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner capitalises
scenarios.trigger: If Lamlash gets away with very soft fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The loose lead gives Lamlash enough of an advantage that the closers can't peg him back despite their superior class. Belle Amie emerges best of the rest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runner strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Belle Amie tracks Lamlash closely and times her move perfectly
scenarios.body: Belle Amie's positioning advantage pays dividends as she doesn't give the back markers enough time to wind up their finishes. Highland Harvey makes late ground but falls just short.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lamlash crawls through glacial splits and multiple closers converge
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with numerous hold-up horses finishing in a blanket. The freshest or luckiest in running prevails from a tight finish.

watchPoints.text: Lamlash getting away with very soft fractions could make him hard to peg back despite his poor record
Belle Amie's tactical positioning as the only prominent runner gives her a significant edge over the hold-up horses
Buck Barrow's previous course win came on softer ground so current good going may not suit ideally
Highland Harvey and Hedonista both returning from lengthy breaks which could blunt their finishing kicks
The small field size increases the chances of traffic problems affecting the numerous hold-up runners

runners_data.name: Ghost Story

races.paceDynamic: Mighty Quiet emerges as the only natural front-runner in this small field, with all other runners showing hold-up tendencies. This setup creates a dream scenario for the leader, as she can dictate terms without early pressure and control the tempo throughout. The lack of pace pressure means the early fractions will be steady, setting up a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and those able to track the pace closely, as the hold-up horses will face a difficult task from the back in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mighty Quiet Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Mighty Quiet jumps alertly and gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions and prove very hard to peg back in the straight. The lack of early pace pressure allows her to conserve energy for a strong finish while others struggle to make up ground from detached positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The race develops into a sprint finish where class and tactical positioning matter most. Ghost Story or Zambezi Magic could benefit from their strong recent form if they can get close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Risen Again Finds Best Form
scenarios.trigger: If Risen Again recaptures his Alice Haynes form under different handling
scenarios.body: The former 1m2f winner could exploit the trip and conditions despite his recent disappointing efforts. His hold-up style needs the pace to be strong enough to bring him into contention late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Mighty Quiet goes too slowly and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy tactical affair where any horse getting first run could prevail. Premier or Crackergee might benefit from the chaos despite their current form concerns.

watchPoints.text: Mighty Quiet breaking slowly or getting headed early would completely change the race dynamic and favour late runners
Ghost Story and Zambezi Magic positioning in the early stages, as they need to be close enough to strike in a tactical finish
William Carson's tactics on Risen Again, whether he attempts to get closer to the pace given the likely slow tempo
Any horse showing keen early tendencies that could disrupt Mighty Quiet's rhythm and create genuine pace pressure
How quickly the field bunches turning for home, indicating whether the pace was slow enough to bring all runners into contention
